item.description:
WhoNext 1.0 (060)

Whole-transcript Claude analysis, with one ChatGPT/Codex fallback, and corrections to recording, transcription timing and recovery.

  • Claude receives the complete conversation and participant context together, producing a comprehensive note and evidence-backed speaker proposals. Automatic local Qwen notes and routine multi-stage note synthesis are removed from this path.
  • Stop drains accepted audio before files close. Durable job claims, fenced checkpoints and reusable transcription chunks reduce duplicate work and allow interrupted processing to resume.
  • Apple/Whisper routing is consistent; confidence checks are engine-specific. Partial word alignment preserves text and marks timing uncertainty. System-audio offsets are corrected.
  • Names can use cross-speaker introduction and substitute evidence. Actions distinguish requester, proposed owner and accepted commitment. Unresolved voices retain stable speaker labels.
  • Settings expose separate Claude and ChatGPT/Codex status, sign-in and refresh actions. O365 remains separately connected; missing calendar access does not prevent notes.
  • Provider process cleanup is bounded; a complete note must validate before acceptance. Five minutes is a progress milestone, not a whole-meeting cancellation timer.

Manual-validation release: 476 local tests passed, 3 were skipped, and none failed. Retained-meeting replays, the 90-minute production run, real-provider end-to-end checks and the Teams smoke test remain pending. Real-meeting accuracy and latency are not yet certified.

Requires macOS 26.0 or later. Built with Xcode 27 beta. After updating, check Claude, ChatGPT/Codex and O365 connection status in Settings before testing.
